name: Fatal Impact Chromatic Aberration
purpose: Simulate optical lens distortion and shockwave RGB split on lethal headshots or sniper recoil.
required_visual_conditions: Frame with high motion or sudden gunfire.
fusion_node_structure:
MediaIn1 -> ChannelBooleans1 (Red) -> Transform1 (X: +3px)
MediaIn1 -> ChannelBooleans2 (Green) -> Passthrough
MediaIn1 -> ChannelBooleans3 (Blue) -> Transform2 (X: -3px)
Merge back via ChannelBooleans Add -> MediaOut1
resolve_implementation_instructions: Fusion Page: Split R/G/B channels with ChannelBooleans, apply horizontal micro-shift to Red and Blue, keyframe return to 0.
qa_procedure: Verify distortion snaps back to clean un-split image within 8 frames to avoid causing eye strain.
